set.body:
Goal: parse and preserve EyeLink native event, message, and metadata records independently of timeline materialization.

Acceptance criteria:
- SFIX/EFIX, SSACC/ESACC, SBLINK/EBLINK retain eye, exact numeric tokens, source location, raw record, and block context.
- MSG retains logged timestamp, optional signed integration offset, effective timestamp, and exact payload including numeric-leading payloads.
- Calibration, validation, drift, Data Viewer integration, recording/system, and unknown metadata remain typed or losslessly native.
- Native event values carry an explicit vendor-source algorithm identity and cannot become DetectionResult.
- Malformed native rows and invalid offsets are rejected with bounded line diagnostics; no line is dropped.
- Reference-backed and mutation tests cover simultaneous messages, numeric payloads, malformed summaries, and message-offset corruption on JVM and Scala.js.

Out of scope: constructing ObservedTimeline, reconciling blink intervals into sample validity, or assembling trusted Recording artifacts; those remain in the parent tickets.
set.title: Parse lossless EyeLink native event, message, and metadata records
